input.quote: (e) THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE IN LIEU OF ALL OTHER WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
input.rationale: Section 5's warranties are limited to legal compliance, rights/authority, non-infringement and anti-bribery; there is no warranty that the Works, software deliverables or Services conform to documentation or Specifications, no warranty period, and no repair/replace/refund remedy, while paragraph 5(e) disclaims all implied warranties (so implied conformity cannot fill the gap). Paragraph 1(b) requires Contractor to perform the Services "in a professional and workmanlike manner in accordance with industry standards" as a performance covenant, but supplies no warranty duration or remedy. That fails the fallback on material terms, so we insert the shortest fallback warranty (90 days software conformance to documentation, 30 days Services, repair/replacement or refund) rather than the preferred 12-month/90-day package.

ops.text: Contractor represents and warrants that, for ninety (90) days following delivery, each software deliverable included in the Works will conform in all material respects to its documentation, and that, for thirty (30) days following performance, the Services will conform to the requirements of this Agreement. Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at Contractor's option, repair or replacement of the non-conforming software deliverable or Services, or a refund of the fees paid for them.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 5 contains no conformance warranty or remedy for defective work, so we added our fallback position: 90 days for software conformance to documentation, 30 days for the Services, with repair, replacement or refund of fees paid.
proposal.summary: Add fallback performance warranty: 90-day software conformance to documentation, 30-day Services warranty, repair/replace or refund remedy.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
